title: A press on the supplement list's padding, released with no click and no pointercancel, leaves the press held: an empty search then stays open on blur
evidence: Inherited from main (the pressInList ref did the same). widget-src/src/lib/supplement-add.ts: pressedList sets held; only pressCancelled, pressedOutside, escaped and added release it, and focusLeft keeps an empty search open while held. A pointerdown on the .supplement-dropdown's padding or border (not an option) ends with a pointerup and no click, so held stays true and the empty search no longer closes on blur (#985) until a press outside or Escape. Fix if wanted: release on the list's pointerup when it chose nothing, keeping AC30g (the iPhone's blur comes between pointerdown and click). Found in the review of PR 1749
